name: Beat Lamp
description:
Audio-reactive lamps and redstone emitters that pulse to the beat of jukebox music. Works with vanilla discs, resource pack music, and modded music discs.

Features:
- Beat Lamp: 6 reactive modes (Pulse, RGB, Spectrum, Ripple, Wave, Scan), 16 dye colors + OLED rainbow, frameless styling, and particle effects.
- Beat Emitter: Outputs redstone power (0-15) dynamically reacting to jukebox bass and music energy.
- Lamp Controller: Link lamps into synchronized groups with live preview, bind to specific jukeboxes, or configure all settings.
